# Better Auth Documentation (llms.txt)

> The most comprehensive authentication framework for TypeScript.
> Official reference: https://better-auth.com/docs/llms.txt
> Full documentation: https://better-auth.com/docs

## Project Conventions

In this project, Better Auth is integrated with Next.js 16 (App Router), Prisma 7, and PostgreSQL:

- **Server Instance (`src/lib/auth.ts`)**: Configured with `betterAuth({ ... })`, using `prismaAdapter(prisma, { provider: "postgresql" })` and `nextCookies()` plugin.
- **Client Instance (`src/lib/auth-client.ts`)**: Initialized with `createAuthClient` from `better-auth/react` and `inferAdditionalFields<typeof auth>()`.
- **API Handler (`src/app/api/auth/[...all]/route.ts`)**: Exposes catch-all auth endpoints using `toNextJsHandler(auth)`.
- **Route Protection / Proxy (`src/proxy.ts`)**: Lightweight route gate using `getSessionCookie(request)` from `better-auth/cookies`.
- **Server Authorization Guards (`src/lib/auth-guard.ts`)**: Centralized server-side helpers (`requireAuth`, `requireAdmin`, `requireStudent`) calling `auth.api.getSession({ headers: await headers() })`.
- **OAuth Provider**: Google OAuth only (`clientId`, `clientSecret`).
- **Domain Restriction**: Enforced via `databaseHooks.user.create.before` hook in `auth.ts` requiring `@ves.ac.in` emails.
- **Additional User Fields**: `pushNotificationsEnabled` (boolean) and `emailNotificationsEnabled` (boolean).

---

## Quick Reference & APIs

### Server-Side Session Verification (Server Actions & Components)
```typescript
import { auth } from "@/lib/auth";
import { headers } from "next/headers";

const session = await auth.api.getSession({
    headers: await headers()
});

if (!session?.user) {
    // Unauthenticated
}
```

### Client-Side Authentication (React Components)
```typescript
import { authClient } from "@/lib/auth-client";

// Hook
const { data: session, isPending, error } = authClient.useSession();

// Google Social Sign-In
await authClient.signIn.social({
    provider: "google",
    callbackURL: "/dashboard"
});

// Sign Out
await authClient.signOut({
    fetchOptions: {
        onSuccess: () => {
            window.location.href = "/";
        }
    }
});
```

### Proxy / Edge Cookie Check
```typescript
import { getSessionCookie } from "better-auth/cookies";
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";

export async function proxy(request: NextRequest) {
    const sessionCookie = getSessionCookie(request);
    if (!sessionCookie) {
        return NextResponse.redirect(new URL("/", request.url));
    }
    return NextResponse.next();
}
```

## Core Documentation Index

### Concepts & Architecture
- [API Reference](https://better-auth.com/docs/concepts/api): Calling Better Auth endpoints on server, headers, and error handling.
- [Client Reference](https://better-auth.com/docs/concepts/client): Client setup, React hooks, and plugin inference.
- [Cookies](https://better-auth.com/docs/concepts/cookies): Cookie prefixes, attributes, session cookies, and proxies.
- [Database](https://better-auth.com/docs/concepts/database): Core schema (user, session, account, verification) and database hooks.
- [Hooks](https://better-auth.com/docs/concepts/hooks): Before and after hooks for modifying requests/responses and validation.
- [Session Management](https://better-auth.com/docs/concepts/session-management): Expiration, cookie caching, and session lifecycle.
- [TypeScript](https://better-auth.com/docs/concepts/typescript): Type inference, additional fields typing, and client plugins.
- [Users & Accounts](https://better-auth.com/docs/concepts/users-accounts): Managing profiles, account linking, and user mutations.

### Integrations & Adapters
- [Next.js Integration](https://better-auth.com/docs/integrations/next): App router setup, route handlers (`toNextJsHandler`), server actions, and middleware.
- [Prisma Adapter](https://better-auth.com/docs/adapters/prisma): Prisma integration with custom client and multi-file schemas.
- [Google Social Provider](https://better-auth.com/docs/authentication/google): Google OAuth configuration, credentials, and callback workflows.

## Usage Notes for AI Assistants

- **Installed Version**: Better Auth `^1.7.4` (1.7.x release line). Do not use v2.x or legacy v0.x APIs.
- **Raw Markdown Access**: Append `.md` to any doc URL path to fetch raw Markdown content (e.g. `https://better-auth.com/docs/integrations/next.md`).
- **Citation Rule**: Cite canonical URLs without the `.md` suffix.
- **Server vs Client**: When executing logic inside server actions or route handlers, always use `auth.api.<endpoint>({ headers: await headers() })`. Never import or call `authClient` in server files (`"use server"`).
- **Domain Restriction**: The `@ves.ac.in` domain restriction is enforced in `databaseHooks.user.create.before`. Do not bypass this hook when modifying user creation workflows.
- **Role Enforcement**: Better Auth manages basic user identity; roles (`Admin` vs `Student`) and onboarding approval states are managed through application Prisma models queried via `src/lib/auth-guard.ts`.

---

## Maintenance

- **Source of Truth**: https://better-auth.com/docs/llms.txt (v1.7.x release line).
- **MCP Server**: `https://mcp.better-auth.com/mcp` for searching and retrieving live Better Auth docs.
- **Re-sync when**: Better Auth has a minor/major version upgrade in `package.json`, or if auth adapter configurations change.
